about: Reference numbers from Pillow 12.3.0 ImageFilter.GaussianBlur (3 extended box passes) and from the original renderer's route glow (overview end frame, 1920x1080, core line suppressed). Inputs are described by numbers; outputs are 8-bit values. Rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1, value] with inclusive corners; spans are [y, x0, x1, value].
